name: style3d-app
description: Style3D expo kiosk app packaged with Electron.
author: Style3D

scripts.export: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('out/index.html')) { console.error('Missing out/index.html. Run npm run build:next first.'); process.exit(1); } console.log('Static export available in out/.');"
scripts.electron:start: npm run build:next && npm run export && electron electron/main.js
scripts.dist: npm run build:icon && npm run build:next && npm run export && electron-builder --win --publish=never
scripts.dist:win:x64: npm run build:icon && npm run build:next && npm run export && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish=never
scripts.dist:win:nsis: npm run build:icon && npm run build:next && npm run export && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish=never
scripts.dist:win:portable: npm run build:icon && npm run build:next && npm run export && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --publish=never
